title: Use bodies for anatomy only at an authorised school
what: Use bodies for teaching, studying or practising anatomy only at an authorised school of anatomy.

sources.title: Transplantation and Anatomy Act 1979 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not use the body, or a part of the body, of a deceased person for any of the following purposes otherwise than at an authorised school of anatomy: (a) the teaching and study of anatomy; (b) the practice of anatomy

reach.condition: if it conducts anatomical examinations of bodies (such as a medical school)
